title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramel Latte Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Caramel Latte Flavour Concentrate by Vampire Vape Desserts combines the comforting flavour of roasted Coffee with sweet Caramel and smooth, steamed milk. This coffee-inspired DIY concentrate delivers a mellow blend of sweetened latte-style notes, offering a satisfying vape for fans of coffeehouse flavours and creamy e-liquid profiles. This 30ml concentrate is intended for DIY e-liquid mixing and must be diluted before use. Combine with your chosen VG/PG base mix and, if required, nicotine shots to create your ideal vape. Vampire Vape recommends a dilution of 15–20%, depending on your flavour strength preferences. Made in the UK and blended with a 100% PG base, Caramel Latte is not suitable for direct vaping. Also available as a 10ml Freebase e-liquid and a high-VG Shortfill within the Vampire Vape Desserts collection.
